answer: What survives to the river is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the sable of a task receipt, and the anchor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
